verification.notes: The corrected proposition matches the retained flight evidence: archived ADS-B traces place SU-BTT on a Paris-to-Minot-to-Provo routing on September 4, on the ground at Provo until September 10, arriving near Wilmington on September 10, and leaving the Wilmington area toward Cairo on September 11. verification.notes: The lawsuit-timing portion is supported, but the aircraft-location portion is false. Two independent archived ADS-B networks place SU-BTT on a Cairo–Paris–Omaha–Lincoln route on July 20, remaining at Lincoln until July 26, then routing through Wilmington before Cairo. Owens explicitly corrected the six-day Wilmington claim in the next episode. The July 20–26 Delaware overlap used to imply a Macron connection therefore does not exist.
